title: QR code
description: A scannable QR code as one SVG: VietQR / EMVCo payment payloads, receipts (print variant), links. Fixed black modules on white with a 4-module quiet zone in both themes, four error-correction levels, optional caption and copy button.
when: Show a payment QR (VietQR) in a payment dialog, or print one on a receipt.
Share a short link or a code a phone must scan.

instead.need: A value to copy, no scanning
A logo in the centre of the code
instead.use: Not supported: a centre mark covers modules. Put the logo beside the code

a11y: The SVG is role="img" named by `label` (required): a QR code has no text of its own, so say what it pays or opens. Put the readable data (amount, order number) in `caption`.
Modules are always black on white, in the dark theme too: scanners need dark-on-light and the quiet zone. Do not recolour them.
A value too long for the level shows a short message (role="alert") and calls `onError`; nothing throws.
notes: Encoded with the `uqr` package (MIT, no dependencies, no network). The payload is not validated: pass what the payment provider gave you, unchanged.
Level M (default) suits screens; Q or H for printed codes that may get scuffed. Higher levels hold less data.
